Practised choosing exact or approximate values in everyday situations.
Identified attendance counts and scores as exact values.

end.parentNote: Asha practised deciding when an exact value is needed and when an estimate is more useful; Ayaan explained the examples of attendance, scores, and crowds using sensible reasons. They also discussed rounding large numbers and understood that an approximate value can be easier to use, but the rounding of 26,400 to lakhs was mixed up and was not corrected in the recorded turns. At home, practise rounding a few numbers such as 26,400 and 3,70,000 to the nearest lakh, then ask Ayaan to explain why the chosen place is sensible.
